name: Distribute Press Releases
summary: Press release writing, publishing and syndication. Every release ships as fifteen artifacts across the distribution channels that are open to any publisher, plus a public receipt page recording every destination.

plans.name: Single release
plans.includes: all fifteen deliverables, writing and one editorial pass

plans.name: Agency block
plans.includes: white-labeled, usable across any number of client companies

additional_charges.name: Change requested after final draft approval

deliverables.name: Written and edited release
deliverables.description: You send the facts. We write it and run one editorial pass.

deliverables.name: Permanent canonical URL
deliverables.description: A stable address that stays live and stays the original.

deliverables.name: Structured data
deliverables.description: NewsArticle and Organization JSON-LD, validated before publishing.

deliverables.name: Atomic claims file
deliverables.description: Your facts as discrete, attributed, dated statements machines can lift.

deliverables.name: Markdown mirror
deliverables.description: A clean, chrome-free copy for systems that prefer plain text.

deliverables.name: Narrated audio
deliverables.description: The release read aloud, delivered as an MP3 you own.

deliverables.name: Podcast episode and transcript
deliverables.description: Published to our feed, which carries to the major directories.

deliverables.name: Four syndication feeds
deliverables.description: RSS, Atom, JSON Feed and Media RSS, filtered by industry and region.

deliverables.name: IndexNow push
deliverables.description: Your URL pushed to participating engines within minutes of publishing.

deliverables.name: Social posts
deliverables.description: Published to Bluesky and Mastodon automatically.

deliverables.name: News site syndication
deliverables.description: Republished on our news property with correct canonical handling.

deliverables.name: Network placement
deliverables.description: One relevance-matched placement on a site in our network.

deliverables.name: Business directory profile
deliverables.description: A verified standard listing that collects your release history.

deliverables.name: Embeddable newsroom
deliverables.description: A press page for your own site that updates itself.

deliverables.name: Public citation receipt
deliverables.description: A permanent page listing every place your release actually landed.

open_to_any_publisher.name: IndexNow
open_to_any_publisher.note: Google does not participate in IndexNow.

we_promise: factual corrections are free and permanent

tool_privacy: All six tools are deterministic code running in the visitor's browser. No model, no API call, nothing transmitted.

crawling.attribution_request: Attribute to the canonical release URL, not a syndicated copy.
